sections.title: Kakeya and Furstenberg problems for sticky sets of tubes
sections.abstract: The authors prove a sharp Furstenberg estimate in R^3 and the Kakeya set conjecture in R^4 for sticky tube configurations satisfying convex Wolff axioms.
sections.claimed_result: For sticky sets of tubes obeying convex Wolff axioms, the authors claim the sharp three-dimensional Furstenberg estimate and the four-dimensional Kakeya conjecture in this restricted setting.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Sticky tube families satisfying convex Wolff axioms; this is not the unrestricted Kakeya conjecture in R^4.
sections.caveat: The theorem is restricted to the sticky case and remains a new preprint claim.

sections.title: Stable De Giorgi conjecture of the Allen–Cahn equation in R^3
sections.abstract: The authors claim that every bounded stable entire Allen–Cahn solution in R^3 is one-dimensional, yielding the full De Giorgi conjecture in R^4.
sections.claimed_result: One-dimensionality of bounded stable entire solutions in three dimensions, with the full monotone-solution De Giorgi conjecture in four dimensions as a consequence.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Bounded, entire, stable solutions of the Allen–Cahn equation; the approach uses geometry of the zero set.
sections.caveat: The result does not resolve the general bounded non-stable problem and remains a preprint claim.

sections.title: Lyapunov stability of polynomial vector fields is undecidable
sections.abstract: For some fixed dimension and odd degree, no algorithm can decide Lyapunov stability from rational coefficients of a homogeneous polynomial vector field.
sections.claimed_result: There exist fixed N and odd D for which stability is undecidable for homogeneous degree-D polynomial vector fields in dimension N.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Rational coefficients, homogeneous polynomial vector fields, and a fixed but large and unoptimized dimension and degree.
sections.caveat: The theorem gives no optimized parameters and does not make every individual stability instance undecidable.

sections.title: Energy minimization for eight points on the sphere
sections.abstract: For eight points on the unit sphere, the unique logarithmic- and Coulomb-energy minimizer up to congruence is a square antiprism; the paper also studies Riesz and other completely monotone energies.
sections.claimed_result: The square antiprism with height determined by a unique stationarity equation is the unique global minimizer for logarithmic and Coulomb energies, with Lean-verified and computer-assisted components.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Exactly eight points on the unit sphere; the optimizer depends on the potential.
sections.caveat: The square antiprism is not universal for all completely monotone potentials, and some conclusions are computer-assisted.

sections.title: On low-discrepancy sequences and Poissonian pair correlation
sections.abstract: The author constructs a sequence with both optimal-order low discrepancy and Poissonian pair correlation.
sections.claimed_result: Existence of a low-discrepancy sequence with Poissonian pair correlation, showing the two properties are compatible.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Sequences in the unit interval; discrepancy measures global uniformity and pair correlation measures local gap statistics.
sections.caveat: The abstract establishes existence, not a canonical or classical construction.
